program.name: Open, Lift, Open
program.subject: Strength & stretch
program.blurb: A short flow to open up, strength in the middle, and a longer flow to close.
program.about: Strength sandwiched between two flows. A short mobility flow opens the joints you are about to load, the lifts come next, and a longer stretch takes them back down. Upper days press and row; lower days squat and hinge. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Flow, upper strength, flow / flow, lower strength, flow
